description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'SimpleWikiHelper' for interacting with a Wiktionary API. It includes methods for preparing a user agent string, fetching page content, and parsing JSON responses from the API. The class also contains custom exceptions for handling API and parsing errors.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to retrieve and parse Wiktionary page content via HTTP API requests. It manages user-agent preparation, request execution, and JSON response parsing. Includes nested exception classes for error handling.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ApiException
classes.description: Exception thrown when there are problems contacting the remote API server.

classes.name: SimpleWikiHelper.ParseException
classes.description: Exception thrown when there are problems parsing API responses.

methods.name: prepareUserAgent
methods.description: Initializes the user agent string with application package name and version, taken from the provided Context.

methods.name: getPageContent
methods.description: Fetches and returns the content of a specific Wiktionary page, optionally expanding templates. Parses the JSON response to extract page content.

methods.name: getUrlContent
methods.description: Performs a synchronized HTTP GET request to the specified URL and returns the response content as a String. Uses a shared buffer for efficiency.
